name: xTool D1 Pro 5W
tagline: 5W The most popular open-frame diode laser for makers who outgrow entry-level machines
tldr: xTool D1 Pro 5W is the 5W SKU on the xTool xtool d1 pro line. A well-built open-frame diode laser available up to 20W. Verify optical power on the listing : do not assume combined-watt marketing.

priceRange.note: 5W optical module : verify SKU before buying

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

cannot: Clear acrylic cutting (diode light passes through)

pros: 5W The most popular open-frame diode laser for makers who outgrow entry-level machines
Open-frame layout : laser glasses and ventilation are your responsibility
Swappable laser head on the same chassis : upgrade wattage without a new machine
Work area 430 × 390 mm (16.9 × 15.4 in) on this chassis
5W on xTool D1 Pro: engraving-first : photo fills and leather at moderate speeds
Reference engrave job on this module: ~25–36 min
cons: This module targets thin cuts (about 3 mm basswood class) : not thick production plywood
Higher modules in this line (10W, 20W or 40W) add cut speed and depth
Not the SKU for a shop cutting 3 mm+ stock all day
Open frame: kids, pets, and smoke are not contained
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 5W module on xTool D1 Pro. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Optimize for engraving: lower DPI on photos, higher scan speed on line art after test burns. Air assist still helps clarity. Compare benchmark times on the next tier before assuming you need more power.
primaryUse: Engraving-first desktop diode for makers who prioritize mark quality over cut speed
mainObjective: Detailed engraving on organics and coated metal : occasional thin cuts only
